ZINC GLUE-ON LEAF BAIL 22X6MM - IMITATION RHODIUM (IR)

This Leaf Bail is a zinc glue-on finding with an Imitation Rhodium electroplate finish, sized 22x6mm overall with a 14x7mm leaf flat base and a closed 6x4mm loop. There's no need for wire wrapping or drilling holes into a focal piece — simply glue the bail to a cabochon, focal component, or freeform piece to create an instant pendant. Each bail has a textured base to hold epoxy or glue in place, works best on a non-porous surface such as glass, and is lacquered to protect the plating. A 2-part epoxy is recommended.

  • Finish: Imitation Rhodium (IR)
  • Material: Zinc
  • Size: 22x6mm overall (14x7mm flat base, 6x4mm closed loop)
  • Mini-pack: 24 pieces
  • Factory pack: 1 gross (144 pieces)

This Leaf Bail is a popular choice for turning cabochons, focal pieces, and freeform stones into instant pendants without wire wrapping or drilling where a silver-tone glue-on finding is appreciated.
